WF-131: where the per-recipient policy matrix lives, and whether the four bundled protections are re-implemented or composed from the workflows that own them.

state.dependencies_on_main: WF-069 gate, WF-070 NDA gate, WF-071 watermark, WF-072 download AND, WF-077 plan, WF-079 audit codes
state.option_a: WF-131 owns a per-recipient policy collection (wf131_recipient_policy) keyed by link_id+recipient, composes the four workflows' pure rules, and logs actions in wf131_protection_action carrying WF-079's integer event_code.
state.option_b: WF-131 re-implements the gate, watermark, download and audit rules itself.
state.option_c: WF-131 writes its per-recipient fields onto the WF-069 link row.
state.evidence: WF-071 already keeps its config in its own collection because a link's owner re-normalises the link payload and drops unknown keys. The brief says to reuse the dependencies' vocabulary rather than re-declare protections.

approach.instructions: Which approach best resolves where the per-recipient matrix lives and how the bundle relates to the four merged workflows?

criteria.option_a: Own collection, compose the four workflows' rules, one action log with WF-079 codes
criteria.option_b: Re-implement all four protections inside WF-131
criteria.option_c: Store the per-recipient fields on the WF-069 link row

decision: Implementation of WF-131 meets the release bar

state.change_summary: WF-131 per-recipient content protection and auditability. New domain package dsr/content_protection (policy matrix, IP allow-list, composing evaluation, action log, vocabulary, errors), a wf131 feature router on /api/wf-131 with FEATURE, EXCEPTION_HANDLERS and seed(), backend domain and HTTP tests, and a React page with its own api.js and primitives. The matrix composes the four merged protections (WF-069 gate/expiry, WF-070 NDA, WF-071 watermark, WF-072 download AND, WF-077 plan gate) rather than re-implementing them; action rows carry WF-079's integer event_code. Stored in two new namespaced collections, no migration and no schema change.

verdict.instructions: Should this change land on main? Weigh the balance of the questions above rather than deciding on your own: where contract_compliance, audit_integrity and design_floor are all healthy and the evidence questions show broad coverage, answer merge with the confidence that warrants. Items listed as unverified are declared context to weigh, not defects in themselves -- but a change whose coverage is genuinely thin, or which was recovered from a base far behind main and not reconciled, is fix.
